learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn to read time in hours and minutes, and explore months and days on a fun calendar!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The short hand on the clock tells us the hour, and the long hand tells us the minutes. There are 60 minutes in one full hour!
We use AM for the morning time before lunch, and PM for the afternoon, evening, and dark night time.
A calendar shows us the days, weeks, and months. A whole year has 12 months, and some months have 30 days while others have 31.

fun_activity.title: ⏰ My Daily Routine
fun_activity.instructions: Write down the exact time you wake up, eat lunch, and go out to play in your notebook. Do not forget to write AM or PM!

quick_recap: ⭐ The clock has two main hands to show us the exact hour and minute.
⭐ AM is used for the morning, and PM is used for the afternoon and night.
⭐ A calendar helps us keep track of days, weeks, and special festivals in a year.
